title: feat(spec): a settings toggle can declare the question asked before it is turned off (confirmOffText)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNkSattAQgfbhSPyCVSo2PJ)_

Fixes #30418
Ruling-ref: 6657805240

Clause-②: yes (widening: an optional `confirmOffText` on toggle specifiers; refused on every other specifier type)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none owed — a settings manifest is platform code that no app can declare, and no `skills/**` file teaches a specifier key (`git grep -n -iE "specifier|settings.?manifest|email_password_enabled" -- skills/`: two hits, `skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md:354`, which names the `feature_flags` manifest and no key, and `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md:193`, which says `settings` is platform-only and stays true)
Prior rulings read: confirmofftext,confirmtext,settings manifest toggle → 0 hits; none; thread: 1 ruling(s) (6657805240); repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack
Liveness: not governed — the liveness ledger walks registered metadata kinds plus the unregistered kind map (`authorableTypes()` in `check-liveness.mts`); a settings manifest is neither, and no `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` carries a `Specifier` row, so there is no row to add. `check:liveness` green.
Carried: #30500, the `domain:ui` half (ruling (4)): the console's settings page asks `confirmOffText` before it saves a toggle turned off. Until it lands the key parses and is declared but is not shown.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置清单的开关项（`toggle`）新增可选键 `confirmOffText`，即「关闭前要弹出的确认文字」；其他类型的设置项声明它会在解析时被拒绝。认证设置里的「启用邮箱/密码登录」开关声明了这句话（英、中、日、西四种语言）。
- 为什么改：Setup 关闭邮箱/密码登录时不做任何提示，而用密码登录的人会因此需要别的登录方式；设置页是通用渲染器，此前没有声明式的办法让某个开关在关闭前先确认（维护者裁决 A，6657805240）。
- 风险与回滚：只新增可选键，没声明的清单行为不变；目前控制台还不读这个键（属于 `domain:ui` 后半），所以本 PR 落地后界面暂时没有变化。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts` 新键与 superRefine 新增的拒绝分支；`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/auth.manifest.ts` 的声明；`settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` 新增的覆盖要求。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/system/settings-manifest.test.ts`，预期 78 例全绿，其中 `Specifier.confirmOffText` 一组 7 例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`SpecifierSchema.confirmOffText`** (`packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts`): `I18nLabelSchema.optional()`, described as "Confirm dialog text shown before a toggle's value changes to off (omit = no confirm)". Its TSDoc names the translation address and the toggle-only rule.
- **Toggle only:** the specifier `superRefine` gains one arm beside the `valueDomain`-on-a-layout-specifier arm. On any `type` but `toggle` it adds a `custom` issue at `['confirmOffText']`: "Specifier of type 'TYPE' has no off to confirm, so it must not declare a 'confirmOffText' (only a 'toggle' may)." It is an arm on the existing refinement, so no dropped-refinements row (the spec build is green).
- **Translation path** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`): the platform face's `settings.NS.keys.KEY` entry gains the leaf `confirmOffText`, beside the toggle's `label`, and the convention comment lists `settings.NS.keys.KEY.confirmOffText`. The `keys` entry is a strict object, so without this leaf two doors refuse a bundle carrying the text: `PlatformTranslationDataSchema` at parse, and `tsc` on the service's bundle literals, which are typed `PlatformTranslationData`. (The service's `kernel:ready` hook loads the bundle into the i18n service unparsed, `settings-service-plugin.ts` :296-302, so the runtime itself would not refuse it.) This is the translation half of "translated like the toggle's other text"; it sits in the platform-only `settings` group, which both app-authored doors already refuse.
- **`auth.manifest.ts`**: `email_password_enabled` declares `confirmOffText: 'People who sign in with a password will need another way in.'` (the #30299 sentence), and the four shipped bundles carry it at `settings.auth.keys.email_password_enabled.confirmOffText` (en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES).
- **`settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`**: a declared `confirmOffText` is held to the same per-locale coverage as the toggle's label (`key:KEY.confirmOffText` is reported missing), and a bundle `confirmOffText` on a key that declares none is reported as undeclared copy.
- **Regenerated** with the repo's generators: `authorable-surface/system.json` (`system/Specifier:confirmOffText`, written by the spec build), `content/docs/references/system/settings-manifest.mdx` and `translation.mdx` (`gen:docs`). `check:llms-txt` re-derived its 98 claims with no change (llms.txt counts schemas, not keys).
- `.changeset/30418-settings-toggle-confirm-off.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor (the protocol change), `@objectstack/service-settings` patch (a manifest declaration and its copy, graded as #30202 graded its manifest change), with both declaration lines.

## Tests

- `settings-manifest.test.ts`, describe `Specifier.confirmOffText — a toggle asks before it goes off`: accepted on a toggle with its text; accepted as an inline locale map; absent still parses and reads `undefined`; refused on `text` and `select` (value-bearing) and `group` and `action_button` (layout), each with a control that the bare specifier parses, then exactly one `custom` issue at `['confirmOffText']` whose message names the type and the key.
- `translation.test.ts`: the platform face accepts `settings.auth.keys.email_password_enabled.confirmOffText` with full `safeParse` success and keeps the value.
- `auth.manifest.test.ts`: the parsed manifest's `email_password_enabled` is a `toggle` carrying the sentence, and the en bundle carries the same text at its address.
- `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`: the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES rows for `settings.auth` now also require the `confirmOffText` leaf (green with the three translations).

## Acceptance notes

- No `resolveSettingsFieldConfirmOff` helper is added to `i18n-resolver.ts` beside `resolveSettingsActionConfirm`: the console resolves settings copy through its own `useSettingsLabel`, and the ruling binds no resolver export. If the `domain:ui` half wants one, it is a small spec addition there.
- The message is not pinned word for word; the pins assert the code, the path, and that it names the key and the type, which is what the ruling requires.

## Verification

Measured at head `14289976ed` (local subset; CI families are the PR's own check-runs). Head `1a29fff73a` (review round 1) changes only the changeset grade and one test comment; on it `translation.test.ts` passes 218/218 and the Check Changeset family reruns green: `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` exit 0 ("This diff introduces no `major` bump."), `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exit 0, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0, `pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests` exit 0.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` under os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 815 passed (815), Tests 25626 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test && … typecheck` under os-verify-lock (closure built first): VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 68 passed (68), Tests 1157 passed; `tsc --noEmit` clean.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` after `gen:docs`: every artifact current (the first run named only `content/docs/references/**` stale, which `gen:docs` regenerated).
- Ablation, one leg (commit first, then mutate): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the anchor `if (spec.confirmOffText !== undefined && spec.type !== 'toggle') {` with `if (false) {` (anchor 1 → 0, blob cc1a18591108 → 4425afbb53ce) and ran `vitest run src/system/settings-manifest.test.ts`: Tests 4 failed, 74 passed — exactly the four refusal pins (text, select, group, action_button). Restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The spec test imports the schema from source, so no dist leg is needed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "106 derived, 106 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Four families first exited 3 (prerequisite: a shallow clone for `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`; built dists for `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`); after `git fetch --unshallow origin main` and a full `turbo run build --concurrency=2` (VERDICT command-exit 0) all four exit 0. `check-changeset-no-major`: "This diff introduces no `major` bump."
- Local-only: `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` exit 0; `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 30418 --terms …`: exit 0, line above.
